requirements: Read the commit and object format from the physical candidate repository root with Git object replacement disabled.
Compare the exact Git file list and blob identity with the measured runtime paths. An untracked, changed or missing file fails even when HEAD has the requested commit.
For isolated PHP runs, make only the verified source and resource trees available from the candidate. Restore any omitted locked files before collecting evidence.
Hold the commit and distribution constant from the start of observation collection through the final verification and during evidence replay.
trust: The verifier controls the checkout, Git object store and container engine. A successful comparison does not protect a downstream Composer installation or a checkout altered by another process between reads.
